simple.summary: מַלְכֹּדֶת (malkôdeth) means a snare First listed occurrence: Job 18 10.

definitions.full: H4434. malkodeth [ מַלְכֹּ֑דֶת ] noun feminine a catching instrument , i.e. a snare, trap, only figurative; suffix נָתִיב עֲלֵי מַלְכֻּדְתּוֺ Job 18:10 of the wicked (|| חַבְלוֺ בָּאָרֶץ טָמוּן ).
